pr_title: Fix can't add multiple iCloud accounts (remove account name)
pr_body:
## Breaking Change:

`account_name` is removed from the config.yaml, nothing change for the config flow.

## Description:

When I refactored and added the config flow to iCloud, I kept the `account_name` config for yaml, as for legacy, but the only use of it is in iCloud device attributes ...

Also I added a check for already configured iCloud integration, and in that case when you add multiple iCloud via the UI, you will always get "Account already configured" (cf #30877) because it checks `None == None` [here](https://github.com/home-assistant/home-assistant/blob/d63ea198f2a9d65e2be4160f33688534744605df/homeassistant/components/icloud/config_flow.py#L53).

The cause is [in the config_flow](https://github.com/home-assistant/home-assistant/blob/d63ea198f2a9d65e2be4160f33688534744605df/homeassistant/components/icloud/config_flow.py#L94), it should have [this from the init](https://github.com/home-assistant/home-assistant/blob/d63ea198f2a9d65e2be4160f33688534744605df/homeassistant/components/icloud/__init__.py#L265).


I've coded an other fix without breaking change and keeping the `account_name` but as I think it is useless, I prefer clean the code (will link later).

**Related issue:** fixes #30877

**Pull request with documentation for [home-assistant.io](https://github.com/home-assistant/home-assistant.io):** home-assistant/home-assistant.io#11800

## Checklist:
  - [x] The code change is tested and works locally.
  - [x] Local tests pass with `tox`. **Your PR cannot be merged unless tests pass**
  - [x] There is no commented out code in this PR.
  - [x] I have followed the [development checklist][dev-checklist]

If user exposed functionality or configuration variables are added/changed:
  - [x] Documentation added/updated in [home-assistant.io](https://github.com/home-assistant/home-assistant.io)

If the code does not interact with devices:
  - [x] Tests have been added to verify that the new code works.

[dev-checklist]: https://developers.home-assistant.io/docs/en/development_checklist.html
pr_comments:
Is it possible to do those reviews on a next PR @MartinHjelmare ?

This PR was created first to fix 0.104 about the inability to add two iCloud integrations to HA.
Modifying the tests and using unique id per config entry will make the PR much longer than expected.

I can look at it this week-end, if so, I should also change Linky (dev), Météo-France (#29927), Freebox (#30334), and the almost done Synology DSM (soon) !!!
Also, if you can look at the linked PR, I would be very happy :smile:

Setting unique_id should be drop in replacement more or less for the check we have now. Use username as unique_id.

For the test change I've given very precise change instructions. Don't change any other tests than that test. Clean up of other tests can be done later.
It's ok to wait with unique_id if that looks uncertain.

Tests modified (not only that one perhaps, but all similar).

Tried with unique_id but I got `AttributeError: 'IcloudFlowHandler' object has no attribute 'context'` for tests that still use `await flow.async_step_user()`. Don't know how to update them for now.
I don't think we should include this in a patch release for 0.104. We normally don't include breaking changes in patch releases. I'm also not sure it would apply cleanly to the release branch.

issue_context.title: iCloud integration does not allow a second account to setup
issue_context.body:
**Home Assistant release with the issue:**
hassos: "2.12"
homeassistant: 0.104.0
machine: raspberrypi3
supervisor: "195"

**Operating environment (Hass.io/Docker/Windows/etc.):**
Hass.io

**Integration:**
https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/icloud/

**Description of problem:**
It is not possible to setup a second iCloud account with a different mail address:

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/11849583/72593286-e56d0100-3904-11ea-878d-34820a1453d8.png)


Regards
Richard
comments: Hey there @Quentame, mind taking a look at this issue as its been labeled with a integration (`icloud`) you are listed as a [codeowner](https://github.com/home-assistant/home-assistant/blob/dev/CODEOWNERS#L156) for? Thanks!

@cyberfly79 & @darootler :

I coded two fixes one that keep the account name configuration, one not (much cleaner).

Both of the account names (from previous config + new one) are `None` and they should use the first part of your email, you came to this when you enter multiple config via the UI.

When I updated the iCloud component, and kept the `account_name` for legacy but I shouldn't, since there is no use of it perhaps in the device attributes...

During the time of fix, you can add your second config via the config.yaml file and add a random `account_name` property.

I'll submit the fix tonight or tomorrow.

@Quentame 

The workaround with the second account via configuration.yaml isn't working. After setting it up i am getting the following error:

```shell
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/usr/src/homeassistant/homeassistant/config_entries.py", line 215, in async_setup
    hass, self
  File "/usr/src/homeassistant/homeassistant/components/icloud/__init__.py", line 158, in async_setup_entry
    await hass.async_add_executor_job(account.setup)
  File "/usr/local/lib/python3.7/concurrent/futures/thread.py", line 57, in run
    result = self.fn(*self.args, **self.kwargs)
  File "/usr/src/homeassistant/homeassistant/components/icloud/__init__.py", line 307, in setup
    self.update_devices()
  File "/usr/src/homeassistant/homeassistant/components/icloud/__init__.py", line 341, in update_devices
    self._fetch_interval = self._determine_interval()
  File "/usr/src/homeassistant/homeassistant/components/icloud/__init__.py", line 411, in _determine_interval
    int(min(intervals.items(), key=operator.itemgetter(1))[1]),
ValueError: min() arg is an empty sequence
```

Regards
Richard

I think the workaround is working, check your integrations, it should have both of your accounts. Perhaps, the log indicates the integration is initiated and already fetch your devices once and try to determine the next interval to fetch the next data. Can you go to https://www.icloud.com, connect to the concerned account and locate your device? Is it working? Is it on one of zones divined in Home Assistant? I’ve tried with a new iCloud account, with one device and no location, I have an error but not there (and location is required for the integration), so I don’t know why you have this error for now. Sent with GitHawk
Also, is this account was working in version 0.103.x ? Sent with GitHawk

Yes, everything was working with that two accounts before 0.104.

I have both accounts setup, but the second has no entities:

![42E7C3EB-CE67-4A19-B0FB-C206256F3DF0](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/11849583/72668302-abdfe700-3a25-11ea-9073-e7d5c315248b.jpeg)

Regards
Richard

I just deleted the token and the integration for the second account. After that i was able to successfully setup the second account.

Regards
Richard
The fix will be available in 0.105.0 because it introduces a breaking change (`account_name` param is removed), sorry for the trouble. Sent with GitHawk
